_comment: Machine-readable form of the gates in docs/building-a-game.md §0 Step 2.
`pnpm game:status` computes which gate a game is really at from these
checks, instead of trusting what progress.md claims. Keep the two in sync:
if you change a gate here, change §0, and vice versa.
JSON rather than YAML on purpose — YAML reads better for a hand-edited
config, but it would cost a dependency, and catalog.json already set the
In every `path`, `<slug>` is substituted. `must` / `mustNot` are JavaScript
regular expressions tested against the whole file. `note` is what a human
reads when a check cannot decide on its own.

gates.label: Brief frozen
gates.summary: The owner has signed off what the game is. No code before this.

checks.label: brief.md exists
checks.note: Case A in §0 Step 2 — run the interview and write it.

checks.label: brief is frozen
checks.note: Header still says Draft. Only the owner freezes a brief.

checks.label: no TODO left in the brief
checks.note: A TODO in a frozen brief is a bug in the process.

checks.label: §11 open questions answered
checks.note: brief.md §11 still has rows with an empty Answer column.

gates.label: Plan approved
gates.summary: How it will be built, and how it will be tested, both agreed.

checks.label: plan.md is approved
checks.note: Fill the module map, the SDK call inventory and the task breakdown first.

checks.label: SDK call inventory filled
checks.note: §6 is what makes the monetisation rules reviewable in one place.

checks.label: task breakdown exists
checks.note: progress.md has nothing to track until plan.md §9 lists tasks.

checks.label: test cases written
checks.note: One case ID per acceptance criterion, before the code.

checks.label: progress.md exists
checks.note: Create it with every task from plan.md §9 as todo.

checks.label: i18n strings module exists
checks.note: Every user-facing string lives in src/i18n/ — building-a-game.md §3.11.

gates.label: Verified
gates.summary: Every test case has been run, including on a real phone.

checks.label: no case left todo
checks.note: Unit, manual and static tables must all be resolved.

checks.label: manual pass recorded
checks.note: Record the date and the device in the testplan header.

gates.label: Shipped
gates.summary: Registered in the catalog, and the progress doc closed out.

checks.label: definition of done fully ticked
checks.note: progress.md §2. Do not tick a box you have not observed.

invariants.label: no direct storage or network in game source
invariants.why: Everything platform-shaped goes through the SDK (§3.1). iOS evicts script-writable storage after ~7 days. The service worker is exempt: intercepting fetch events is what it is for.

invariants.label: only session.ts imports the SDK client
invariants.why: One reviewable place for every platform call (§5).

invariants.label: service worker is not registered at root scope
invariants.why: A root-scoped SW breaks per-game installability for every game (§3.8).

invariants.label: locale comes from the platform, not the device
invariants.why: The shell owns the language picker; a game reads it with watchLocale (§3.11). Reading navigator.language ignores the player's choice.
